#!/bin/sh
set -e
# satis gunluk dosya uretimi: /data/giden/satis_<gun>.csv
gun=${1:-$(date +%Y%m%d)}
out=/data/giden/satis_${gun}.csv
{ printf 'id,tarih,tutar\n'; i=1; while [ $i -le 20 ]; do printf '%s,%s,%s\n' $i $gun $((i * 25)); i=$((i + 1)); done; } > "$out"
echo "uretildi: $out $(wc -l < "$out") satir"
